title: Skills and backlog.md tell a session filing a bug into an active sprint to pass --touch
goal: Found by the SP-qxcj7fgy review: ST-dt6xl537 made new --sprint of an active sprint refuse without --touch, but the consumers that file an S1 bug or a landing bug into the active sprint still name only --sprint (skills/backlog/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/kb-backlog/SKILL.md S1 lines and new bug synopsis, skills/item/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/kb-item/SKILL.md bug filed while landing, skills/sprint/SKILL.md and .claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md review step 5, kb/_self/backlog.md Priority and severity and Sprints review lines), so each flow meets a refusal first. Each names --touch beside --sprint for a bug filed into an active sprint.

run: import sys; ok=all('--touch' in l for f in ('.claude/skills/kb-item/SKILL.md','skills/item/SKILL.md') for l in open(f,encoding='utf-8') if 'filed while landing' in l) and all('--touch' in l for f in ('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md','skills/sprint/SKILL.md') for l in open(f,encoding='utf-8') if 'gap as a bug' in l); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
